notes.title: Anomaly Hunter (Free Demo) - sci-fi hidden object puzzler about time-travelling detective, Q4 2020
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1301820/Anomaly_Hunter/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31263647/4464c0426ed107262061a73f6edcb3ff41c11eff.png[/img][/url]

[b]Anomaly Hunter[/b] - sci-fi hidden object puzzler about time-traveling detective.
This is first game by [url=https://store.steampowered.com/pub/hook][b]Hook Games[/b][/url] (ex Konstructors), so we would really appreciate your support.

Play as STID (Space & Time Integrity Department) detective, whose role is to find & fix time anomalies, which cause a lot of trouble all over the universe.

Why do they appear, who is hiding behind all of this - simple accident or evil villain? That's a mystery to solve.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1301820/Anomaly_Hunter/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31263647/d50b2b7cb4e876ae4d33cdb4e110e73087e7b4e1.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Features:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]15 original detailed worlds
    [*]Over 3 hours of fascinating gameplay
    [*]1000+ unique characters and objects, each with its story to tell
    [*]English, Chinese, German, Spanish, Ukrainian & Russian localizations
    [*]Gazillion of Easter eggs, most of them you won't find anyway ¯\_(ツ)_/¯
[/list]

[h1]Play free Demo & Wishlist:[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1301820/Anomaly_Hunter/

[i]Your best,
Hook Games[/i]

notes.title: Sudoku Universe + Killer (50% OFF) / Weeklong deal
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/861270/Sudoku_Killer/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32988905/cc3524b7e1291fd3d869e5b559c3cef3c281cd45.png[/img][/url]

Hey everyone! We're finally live. 
3rd game in our best Sudoku series on Steam is available for download.

Base price $1.99, but you can get it with 50% discount if already have Sudoku Universe (weeklong deal).

[h1]Features[/h1]
Recommended for all Sudoku and puzzles fans. Grab large cup of coffee, get yourself comfortable and go for 50+ hours of mind-teasing experience. 

Killer Sudoku puzzles include all the rules of regular Sudoku but add in dashed-line 'cages' which must sum to given values. Killer Sudoku is also sometimes known as Sumdoku, Mathdoku or Addoku.
[list]
[*] 100 killer Sudoku Killer puzzles
[*] Level's progress save
[*] Beautiful minimalist design, multiple color themes
[*] 10 ambient relaxing soundtracks
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] Trading Cards, Badge, Emoticons and Backgrounds (Coming soon)
[*] Cross-platform Steam Cloud saves
[*] As always - Windows, Mac and Linux support
[/list]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/8845/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32988905/9d1e67945c2d24e80cc890a0f5f11b4f73235b3f.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Bought a game? Write review[/h1]
Each review, positive or negative, provides so important for us feedback; moreover, it gives more visibility for game among Steam recommendation system, which can boost our sales. 

[h1]Become a backer[/h1]
So even with a few words, you can show us your support and help us make our future games. If you like our previous projects, don't hesitate and buy [b]Sudoku Killer[/b] - each copy funds our company and gives us ability to create better games.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/861270/Sudoku_Killer/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/733070/Sudoku_Universe/

[i]Thank you all for your support,
Konstructors team[/i]

notes.title: Zoom beta test
notes.content:
Hey everybody!

We're still working hard on fixing and improving a game. Today we want to share with you beta version of zoom functionality.

To launch beta version of the game:
- right mouse click on game in steam client and choose properties;
- select BETAS tab;
- in dropdown window select 'test'.

All progress you made will be saved in final game.
Please leave your feedback here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/742490/discussions/0/1698294337770025787/

[i]Best regards,
Konstructors team[/i]

notes.title: 1 day
notes.content:
[img=https://i.imgur.com/CUto9yc.png]

Want to remind you, release date - [b]March 22[/b].
Check out our [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=c1kQICnIUh4]Launch trailer[/url], would love to hear your feedback in comments below!

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Over 200 handcrafted picross puzzles (colored, b&w and speed drawing) + Community levels
[*] Level editor (100x100 support)
[*] Workshop
[*] Weekly contests (Winner's levels will be added permanently, custom personal achievement, name in game credits. More details soon)
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] Steam Cloud saves
[/list]

[h1]Coming soon[/h1]
[list]
[*] Steam Trading Cards, Emoticons and Backgrounds
[*] Full controller support
[*] Mac & Linux support
[/list]

Hope you will love it! :)

[i] Thanks for staying with us,
Konstructors team[/i]
